offering_description.value: Insurance brokerage and risk management firm that places commercial property and casualty, employee benefits and personal insurance for businesses and individuals. It earns commissions and fees by arranging coverage with insurance carriers and advising clients on risk.

primary_products.value: commercial property and casualty insurance; employee benefits insurance; personal insurance; specialty program insurance

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage; risk management consulting; claims administration; program administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses across industries, employers buying benefits, program agencies and retail insurance agencies; B2C: individuals buying personal insurance such as auto and homeowners coverage

end_markets.value: construction; healthcare; hospitality; manufacturing; real estate

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions paid by insurance carriers on policies placed for clients; service fees: fees for consulting, claims handling and program administration
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places insurance policies between clients and carriers, earning commissions from carriers; service provider: provides risk advice and claims services to businesses and individuals

geography_served.value: US national: all 50 states, with smaller offices in Canada, the UK, Ireland and Bermuda

specialization.value: related lines: retail brokerage, wholesale brokerage, national programs and services, all selling insurance and risk solutions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house account executives selling to commercial and personal clients; own locations: retail offices across the United States and abroad; agents / brokers: wholesale brokerage serving independent retail insurance agencies
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance brokers must hold state insurance licenses, regulated by state insurance departments
